requirements.statement: The executable basename MUST be `disked`; a native-capable release profile MUST include CLI, machine mode, TUI and its declared GUI in one product entrypoint.
requirements.verification: Inspect composition manifest and execute all declared frontend smoke tests.

requirements.statement: Every advertised operation MUST bind support to target, provider, object state and evidence; planned capability MUST NOT be presented as implemented.
requirements.verification: Compare generated support page with evidence records; inject an unsupported target.

requirements.statement: Initial development MUST use fake targets and disposable images; production physical-write admission is outside this baseline.
requirements.verification: Inspect work grants and exercise a denied raw-device request.

requirements.statement: DiskEd MUST preserve available permitted functions and explicit refusal/uncertainty reasons when optional capabilities fail; it MUST NOT represent denied or unknown observations as empty success.
requirements.verification: Combine healthy, denied, absent and stalled fake targets and compare the retained observations and reasons across all frontends.

requirements.statement: A source-of-truth class MUST have exactly one declared owner; conflicting normative sources MUST block the affected work.
requirements.verification: Create a command/schema conflict and confirm a defect is reported rather than inferred away.

requirements.statement: Approval MUST identify exact content and a real reviewer; generated validation MUST NOT manufacture acceptance or hardware qualification.
requirements.verification: Inspect acceptance schema and reject a digest-mismatched record.

requirements.statement: Each concept MUST have a unique `disked.id`, valid frontmatter and a resolvable index entry; reserved index/log documents MUST remain navigational/history documents.
requirements.verification: Run the structural validator and duplicate-ID/invalid-frontmatter tests.

requirements.statement: Generated projections MUST be reproducible from canonical inputs and MUST NOT be hand-edited.
requirements.verification: Regenerate twice and compare exact bytes; check stale-index failure.

requirements.statement: Consumers MUST distinguish OKF path identity from the stable DiskEd ID and MUST preserve unknown safe extension metadata.
requirements.verification: Move a fixture using an alias and round-trip an unknown extension.

requirements.statement: Every normative requirement MUST map to at least one explicit verification procedure and planned test ID.
requirements.verification: Validator rejects a requirement lacking a test reference.

requirements.statement: Evidence reuse MUST bind relevant content hashes and scope; absent or skipped evidence MUST NOT count as a pass.
requirements.verification: Invalidate a changed dependency fixture and verify qualification is withheld.

requirements.statement: All address and size fields MUST declare units and use checked conversions; UI rounding MUST NOT become storage geometry.
requirements.verification: Round-trip boundary and non-power-of-two-sector examples.

requirements.statement: The application core MUST depend on interfaces rather than concrete platform or GUI providers.
requirements.verification: Static dependency scan plus fake-provider composition test.

requirements.statement: All frontends MUST dispatch the same semantic handlers and consume the same operation outcomes.
requirements.verification: Replay one fixture through CLI, TUI action simulation and GUI action simulation.

requirements.statement: Bulk data MUST use bounded streaming outside the JSON control channel.
requirements.verification: Stress a large sparse image and measure bounded control-message size.

requirements.statement: Canonical specs and machine catalogs MUST remain in `spec/`; generated copies elsewhere MUST identify source paths and hashes.
requirements.verification: Change a catalog and verify stale generated reference detection.

requirements.statement: Repository paths MUST be case-collision-free, portable and ownership-mapped; runtime artifacts MUST remain outside tracked source.
requirements.verification: Path audit with reserved Windows names, case collisions and traversal fixtures.

requirements.statement: Public native interfaces MUST have explicit ownership, versioning and calling convention, without language- or toolkit-private types.
requirements.verification: Compile ABI examples with independent C and C++ clients.

requirements.statement: Every target MUST have an exact toolchain/runtime/import declaration and a real launch test before a compatibility claim.
requirements.verification: Inspect PE imports and run a clean target VM; do not count successful compilation alone.

requirements.statement: Target implementations MUST enforce declared address/memory limits and wire representation independently of native pointer/struct layout.
requirements.verification: Cross-run large-address, byte-order and alignment vectors in modern and constrained probes; unsupported values must fail without truncation.

requirements.statement: DiskEd MUST support a read-only payload root and explicit writable state/evidence roots.
requirements.verification: Launch fixture composition from a read-only directory and verify no adjacent writes.

requirements.statement: The broker MUST ignore ambient user search paths and unbound configuration after plan review.
requirements.verification: Alter a current-directory config and environment variable before apply; verify refusal or no effect.

requirements.statement: A composition MUST declare its loader closure separately from optional runtime components, and MUST reject missing dependencies, cycles and incompatible selections.
requirements.verification: Validate fake manifests with unknown components, dependency cycles, multiple GUI adapters and missing required modules; inspect actual imports before any launch claim.

requirements.statement: A resolved composition MUST preserve exact component/provider identities across build, staging and delivery; no manifest or preset alone grants admission.
requirements.verification: Compare build and staged inventories; replace one provider after plan review and require rejection.

requirements.statement: Essential startup MUST run without opening devices, fetching dependencies, extracting Setup or requesting elevation.
requirements.verification: Trace fake startup with absent providers, corrupt optional settings and offline networking; help/build/command discovery must remain available.

requirements.statement: Every executor/verifier/recovery role MUST bind its execution host and supported plan subset; loss of a remote target MUST NOT redirect to local storage.
requirements.verification: Reconnect and cross-boot fake transcripts with host mismatch, unknown required features and missing remote target; require explicit refusal.

requirements.statement: Explicit conflicting modes MUST return `argument_conflict`; machine modes MUST NOT prompt or initialize a GUI/TUI.
requirements.verification: Evaluate conflict and machine-output fixtures.

requirements.statement: Automatic routing MUST distinguish absent handles from genuine redirection and MUST NOT alter a caller-owned console.
requirements.verification: Run owned/inherited/pipe/absent-handle fixtures plus native launch spike.

requirements.statement: Bare invocation MUST have no storage side effects and MUST expose an explainable mode decision.
requirements.verification: Trace fake-provider calls across all invocation cases.

requirements.statement: Command discovery and dispatch MUST derive from the same canonical descriptor registry.
requirements.verification: Inject a registry entry without a handler and confirm it is not advertised as executable.

requirements.statement: All geometry input MUST have explicit units and unambiguous inclusive/exclusive semantics.
requirements.verification: Reject ambiguous/overflowing input and verify exact integer round trips.

requirements.statement: Mutating convenience commands MUST construct immutable plans and MUST NOT bypass review or broker admission.
requirements.verification: Inspect handler routing using a recording fake provider.

requirements.statement: Moving an accepted complete option/value group among permitted positions MUST preserve normalized command identity, parameters, presentation settings, target scope and safety requirements.
requirements.verification: Run shared equivalence groups and native metamorphic permutations, including command-specific options before the domain and after operands; preserve literal-tail data and reject misplaced/inapplicable options.

requirements.statement: The entire invocation MUST be resolved and validated before product effects or presentation initialization; parsing MUST NOT guess command words from operands or resolve unknown prefixes implicitly.
requirements.verification: Inject late conflicting/unknown flags, missing values, option-looking filenames and command-looking values; recording fake handlers, output-open hooks and frontend hooks observe no dispatch or initialization.

requirements.statement: Contextual help MUST use descriptor-owned meanings, expose registered alternatives and remain available without operation operands, target discovery or elevated authority.
requirements.verification: Compare help at all permitted positions, incomplete domains, unresolved commands and structured output; malformed input remains diagnosed and literal/consumed help tokens stay data.

requirements.statement: Machine messages MUST be bounded, versioned and reject duplicate keys or unknown required features.
requirements.verification: Protocol malformed-message suite plus maximum-size cases.

requirements.statement: Retry and cancellation MUST preserve operation/attempt identities and distinguish an unknown outcome from a completed one.
requirements.verification: Disconnect after dispatch, reconnect and assert no duplicate effect or fabricated cancellation.

requirements.statement: Frontends MUST obtain eligibility and outcomes from the application service, not recalculate storage legality.
requirements.verification: Parity tests compare stale-revision, refused and successful action traces.

requirements.statement: Every visual storage map MUST have a keyboard- and assistive-technology-usable structured equivalent.
requirements.verification: Accessibility inspection and native screen-reader qualification.

requirements.statement: UI selection MUST remain bound to stable object identity across list refreshes and device removal.
requirements.verification: Remove selected fake target and insert another at the same index.

requirements.statement: View modes MUST NOT alter privilege or hard safety constraints; deep scans/elevation MUST be deliberate actions.
requirements.verification: Replay action eligibility across all modes and inspect startup effects.

requirements.statement: Native integrations MUST be thin, explicitly owned and removable; strict portable execution MUST create no persistent registrations.
requirements.verification: Install/remove a fixture adapter, preserve foreign entries, and trace portable execution for zero integration writes.

requirements.statement: Integration selectors MUST be revalidated by the shared engine with explicit host identity before any effects.
requirements.verification: Change drive letter, replace media and disconnect a remote host after selection; no action may follow a stale locator or switch to local storage.

requirements.statement: Terminal detection and rendering MUST use bounded channel-specific capabilities and explicit ownership, preserving usable linear output and caller state.
requirements.verification: Qualify native/VT/DOS/serial backends under narrow, monochrome, redirected, absent-mouse and interrupted-exit fixtures; no runtime result is claimed by the schema fixture.

requirements.statement: Untrusted presentation text and pasted input MUST remain data until explicit command submission; presentation changes MUST NOT change storage identity or authority.
requirements.verification: Exercise control characters, multiline paste, stale selection, completion/history and resize during review; verify no implicit dispatch or loss of critical context.

requirements.statement: The persistent shell MUST be explicitly selected, use canonical typed dispatch and preserve inert editing/completion until submission.
requirements.verification: Compare the fake inventory/inspect/propose/review/simulate journey with CLI/TUI/GUI, including ambiguous aliases, multiline paste and disconnected selection.

requirements.statement: Shell history, prompts and transcripts MUST have explicit ownership, bounds and redaction without substituting for operation evidence.
requirements.verification: Exercise disabled and session-only history, read-only payload roots, secret-bearing inputs and transient prompts; closing the shell must not fabricate operation completion.

requirements.statement: Every presentation MUST derive progress and completion from operation truth, preserving uncertainty and channel separation.
requirements.verification: Compare rich, linear and captured fake transcripts for unknown totals, stale/late events, slow consumers, cancellation and failed verification; accepted submission cannot appear as completed success.

requirements.statement: A destructive target MUST use composite identity and fresh state, never only disk number, path, letter or cloned GUID.
requirements.verification: Reenumeration, duplicate-GUID and absent-serial negative tests.

requirements.statement: Before each dependent effect, the broker MUST check the relevant expected intermediate state under appropriate access control.
requirements.verification: Inject a layout change between plan and apply and between two steps.

requirements.statement: Unknown or conflicting layers MUST remain visible and MUST block unsafe dependent mutation.
requirements.verification: Supply disagreeing map providers and assert a typed refusal.

requirements.statement: Plans MUST account for storage aliases, dependent resources and conflicting actors; unresolved ownership or aliasing MUST block the affected mutation.
requirements.verification: Use multipath, attached-image, same-device recovery and shared-LUN fixtures; a second path or partition must not be mistaken for independent ownership or backup.

requirements.statement: Extent arithmetic MUST be checked and explicitly translate inclusive disk formats to the half-open model.
requirements.verification: Boundary tests at zero, device end and u64 overflow.

requirements.statement: A provider MUST advertise its address-space semantics; non-block media MUST NOT inherit random-write operations by default.
requirements.verification: Offer tape/flux/zoned fixtures to a block-only provider and verify refusal.

requirements.statement: Migration MUST declare nonrepresentable metadata and unreadable content rather than silently report lossless success.
requirements.verification: Cross-filesystem metadata-loss fixture with a digest-bound acknowledgement.

requirements.statement: MBR/EBR/GPT readers MUST enforce range, multiplication, cycle and resource bounds before reads or allocation.
requirements.verification: Malformed corpus plus fuzzing and differential parsers.

requirements.statement: Disagreeing valid GPT copies MUST produce competing observations and require explicit repair authority.
requirements.verification: Create valid but conflicting primary/backup fixtures.

requirements.statement: Table updates MUST preserve unrelated opaque bytes and MUST NOT imply filesystem resizing.
requirements.verification: Byte-diff a fixture around modified entries and compare unchanged regions.

requirements.statement: Provider availability MUST require declared capability plus applicable evidence and policy, not a manifest claim alone.
requirements.verification: Declare an untested mutation and confirm admission is denied.

requirements.statement: Providers MUST NOT silently substitute or execute shell strings; exact code identity and typed arguments MUST be retained.
requirements.verification: Replace provider binary or inject arguments and assert refusal.

requirements.statement: Isolation claims MUST state what is actually enforced, including whether a child can open arbitrary raw paths.
requirements.verification: Threat-model review and sandbox escape/handle-scope tests.

requirements.statement: Windows capabilities MUST be checked per API, filesystem and OS profile; XP MUST NOT inherit Vista-only shrink support.
requirements.verification: API-availability fake fixtures and real XP import/launch qualification.

requirements.statement: System/boot/encrypted or layered storage MUST be routed through dedicated providers and preconditions, not raw bypasses.
requirements.verification: Reject unsupported BitLocker/Storage Spaces/system-volume scenarios.

requirements.statement: Execution eligibility MUST require every mandatory capability dimension to be satisfied; unknown, denied or unqualified state MUST remain explicit.
requirements.verification: Reject an executable assessment with one unknown/failed check; preserve denied and stale fake targets alongside successful observations.

requirements.statement: Provider selection and alternatives MUST be visible, operation-specific and fixed in the reviewed plan; changing a provider requires renewed admission.
requirements.verification: Compare CLI/TUI/GUI capability explanations and reject a provider replacement after review.

requirements.statement: An acquisition MUST declare and substantiate its consistency class, participating volume/writer scope and resume epoch; byte hashes MUST NOT imply coherence or restore readiness.
requirements.verification: Exercise changing-source, expired snapshot, missing writer and multi-volume mismatch fixtures and verify downgraded or refused claims.

requirements.statement: Observation and acquisition MUST separately disclose source, destination and host side effects and their authority.
requirements.verification: Trace bare launch and acquisition planning; no snapshot, self-test or destination overwrite occurs without the selected task and scope.

requirements.statement: Every filesystem/media capability MUST bind exact operation and feature predicates; recognition, creation, mounting and bootability MUST be reported independently.
requirements.verification: Present known format with an unknown critical feature, a tape target and a consumer-incompatible format request; refuse the affected action without hiding inspection.

requirements.statement: Untrusted media, provider output and retrieved repository text MUST NOT expand execution authority.
requirements.verification: Adversarial strings and prompt-injection fixtures across parsers/context ingestion.

requirements.statement: Broker pre-dispatch loading and self-spawn assumptions MUST be threat-modeled; one-file packaging MUST NOT be asserted as sandboxing.
requirements.verification: Inspect imports/initializers and substitution attacks before elevation.

requirements.statement: Hard target/range/recovery invariants MUST NOT be bypassable through a generic force or expert-mode flag.
requirements.verification: Negative command and policy tests.

requirements.statement: Broker admission MUST authenticate the client/session and bind exact plan, policy, executable/provider identities and live target state.
requirements.verification: Replay, endpoint spoofing, swapped-binary and stale-plan adversarial tests.

requirements.statement: Approval MUST be content-bound and MUST NOT authorize altered parameters or later plans.
requirements.verification: Mutate one plan field after approval and require denial.

requirements.statement: Frontend disconnection MUST NOT be interpreted as safe cancellation of an admitted effect.
requirements.verification: Kill client during a fake irreversible stage and inspect durable operation state.

requirements.statement: Planning MUST be side-effect free and produce an acyclic explicit action graph or a cycle witness.
requirements.verification: Recording-provider test asserts no writes; cycle fixture verifies diagnostic.

requirements.statement: Plans MUST bind exact inputs, providers, required critical features and intermediate pre/postconditions.
requirements.verification: Alter each bound input and confirm apply refuses.

requirements.statement: Simulation MUST describe its coverage and limitations; a graph-only simulation MUST NOT certify hardware safety.
requirements.verification: Inspect reports for simulation type and absence of unsupported assurance claims.

requirements.statement: Mutation admission MUST preserve a reachable execution/recovery dependency closure outside the affected scope and required failure domains.
requirements.verification: Model formatting the executable volume, same-device backup, full journal space and volatile recovery state; refuse destructive dependency loss.

requirements.statement: Every admitted mutation MUST declare its recovery class and MUST NOT claim rollback without retained reconstruction data.
requirements.verification: Review overlapping-move fixture and require backup/recovery classification.

requirements.statement: Journal encoding and durability assumptions MUST be accepted before any production journal writer is admitted.
requirements.verification: Decision gate DE-DEC-004 blocks physical-write work.

requirements.statement: Recovery MUST reidentify the target and inspect uncertain effects instead of blindly replaying unsealed steps.
requirements.verification: Crash-at-every-transition model and target-swap tests.

requirements.statement: Execution success MUST be followed by explicit independent postcondition verification where available; mandatory unknowns MUST prevent success certification.
requirements.verification: Fake provider reports success while resulting bytes are wrong.

requirements.statement: Safety-critical live state MUST NOT be satisfied from stale cache, even when unchanged-code tests are reused.
requirements.verification: Reconnect a changed target under a cached inventory entry.

requirements.statement: Performance reporting MUST distinguish submitted, written and verified bytes and disclose unreadable/substituted regions.
requirements.verification: Inject read errors and compare counters and acquisition map.

requirements.statement: Timeout or cancellation request MUST NOT imply quiescence, no effect or permission to retry; uncertain effects MUST prevent conflicting execution until reconciliation.
requirements.verification: Simulate late completion and a worker that never confirms cancellation; verify no replacement writer or false cancelled/success result.

requirements.statement: Every admitted workload MUST have finite target-specific resource limits and a bounded frontend waiting policy, with actual measurements before responsiveness claims.
requirements.verification: Inject stalled/crashed providers, huge input, full destination and slow event consumers; measure limits and verify successful unrelated observations remain usable.

requirements.statement: Target profiles MUST distinguish architecture, loader/API floor, runtime, GUI and operation evidence.
requirements.verification: Reject incomplete profiles and inspect exact release manifests.

requirements.statement: OS-version assets MUST share semantic contracts without claiming cross-architecture binary interchangeability.
requirements.verification: Compare schema/command IDs and run machine-specific launch tests.

requirements.statement: All declared initial Windows lanes MUST be exercised before a Windows-wide support claim.
requirements.verification: Qualification matrix has no untested entries marked supported.

requirements.statement: DOS/Carbon/OS2 adapters MUST use exact host contracts and explicit memory/addressing limits.
requirements.verification: Cross-run canonical binary vectors and boundary cases.

requirements.statement: Unverified historical ABI claims MUST remain blocked integration leads until exact source and tests are captured.
requirements.verification: Check DE-DEC-006 and provider admission manifest.

requirements.statement: Future host/media profiles MUST retain distinct semantics and qualification states rather than inherit block-write capability.
requirements.verification: Inspect planned profile catalog and negative media-role tests.

requirements.statement: Clustered/shared storage mutation MUST require appropriate coordination beyond local mount/lock state.
requirements.verification: Shared-LUN fixture refuses absent cluster authority.

requirements.statement: Every composition MUST explicitly declare single-file, extraction, dependencies and helper exceptions.
requirements.verification: Inspect manifests and run a clean-system one-file qualification.

requirements.statement: Published portable and setup-installed product payloads MUST be byte-identical for the same signed target artifact.
requirements.verification: Hash staged, extracted and installed trees and compare.

requirements.statement: Servicing MUST preserve the exact execution/recovery closure needed by in-progress operations.
requirements.verification: Update/uninstall during a fake active operation and require defer/refusal.

requirements.statement: Embedded/external Setup compositions MUST have finite containment and nonrecursive identity bindings, with ordinary startup free of Setup effects.
requirements.verification: Reject cyclic H/D/S and recursive-hash fixtures; verify payload equality, inactive embedded resources and independent damaged-D recovery before Setup release.

requirements.statement: Setup MUST consume the authoritative portable payload and MUST NOT own or execute DiskEd storage transformations.
requirements.verification: Integration boundary test and byte-equality verification.

requirements.statement: Each lifecycle mode MUST be qualified against the pinned upstream implementation; planned modes MUST be reported as unavailable.
requirements.verification: Exercise occupied-root, scope and unsupported-runtime refusals.

requirements.statement: Public code release MUST wait for an explicit owner license decision and complete dependency notices.
requirements.verification: DE-DEC-001 acceptance and license-closure review.

requirements.statement: A release MUST bind exact sources, dependencies, artifacts and qualification; checksum equality MUST NOT be called authenticity.
requirements.verification: Reproduce unsigned payload and independently verify release signatures where supported.

requirements.statement: Every deployment profile MUST enumerate owned effects, scope and retention; strict portable mode MUST exclude persistent host integration and shared dependency installation.
requirements.verification: Trace portable/user/machine fixture plans, foreign files, external shortcuts and opt-in PATH changes; reject effects outside the selected scope.

requirements.statement: Repair/update/removal MUST preserve component selections, enforced policy, externally owned tools and storage recovery dependencies.
requirements.verification: Repair a console-only installation without adding GUI/drivers; refuse or defer removal of an unreachable generation required for recovery.

requirements.statement: Provider acquisition MUST occur through separately authorized software lifecycle before storage-plan admission, with exact version/source/owner identities.
requirements.verification: Exercise missing offline source, pre-existing external tool and changed provider lock; no implicit network access, ownership takeover or storage execution.

requirements.statement: Provider withdrawal MUST block new admission without silently deleting the exact closure required by active or uncertain operations.
requirements.verification: Revoke a fake provider during unresolved work and verify new-use refusal plus retained recovery material.

requirements.statement: Each installed resource MUST have one servicing owner; channel changes MUST preserve or explicitly transfer ownership and active recovery dependencies.
requirements.verification: Attempt USK repair of MSI-owned payload, concurrent owner updates and channel migration; reject competing writes and preserve retained generations.

requirements.statement: Channel releases MUST use exact finalized payloads and current channel-specific qualification; no generated carrier or signature alone establishes approval.
requirements.verification: Check offline/silent/versioned Store fixture inputs, incompatible driver/MSIX selection, immutable payload equality and missing channel evidence.

requirements.statement: AIDE exports MUST identify the pinned source shape and MUST NOT grant execution authority or fabricate passed work.
requirements.verification: Inspect every exported record for planned/NOT_RUN/false authorization.

requirements.statement: Agent execution privileges and model/budget choices MUST remain separate explicit controls.
requirements.verification: Review grant schema and deny prohibited command/path/hardware operations.

requirements.statement: Generated OKF knowledge MUST reference canonical specs/evidence and MUST NOT become a competing acceptance authority.
requirements.verification: Change source spec and require knowledge freshness invalidation.

requirements.statement: Context packs MUST name exact source hashes, required safety context, budget and omitted optional material.
requirements.verification: Mutate a selected file and require context verification failure.

requirements.statement: A handoff MUST distinguish observed work/tests from proposals and MUST NOT imply GitHub writes or execution without evidence.
requirements.verification: Validate unrun-test and uncommitted-patch examples.

requirements.statement: Required context MUST NOT be silently truncated to meet a budget.
requirements.verification: Build an intentionally undersized pack and expect a typed failure.

requirements.statement: Tool-specific instruction files MUST route to shared authority and remain small; they MUST NOT duplicate the specification.
requirements.verification: Inspect generated root adapters and run link checks.

requirements.statement: Bootstrap MUST be preview-first, non-overwriting and confined to the chosen repository root.
requirements.verification: Conflict, traversal and symlink tests against bootstrap.

requirements.statement: README and public guides MUST preserve product-facing purpose; development progress belongs in status/evidence records.
requirements.verification: Editorial review against the documentation map.

requirements.statement: Generated references MUST bind canonical source hashes and fail freshness checks when the source changes.
requirements.verification: Alter command registry and verify docs generation/check detects drift.

requirements.statement: Spec/tooling validation MUST be labeled separately from product, OS, hardware and recovery qualification.
requirements.verification: Inspect reports for explicit scope and non-capabilities.

requirements.statement: CI MUST operate on disposable fixtures without raw host-device access or release keys.
requirements.verification: Review workflow permissions and denied-path tests.

requirements.statement: Test reuse MUST depend on actual changed inputs and a final composed-artifact qualification.
requirements.verification: Modify a shared primitive/provider lock and inspect impact selection.

requirements.statement: Acceptance MUST be content-bound and attributable; agents MUST NOT manufacture independent review or certification.
requirements.verification: Review acceptance examples and reject missing reviewer/source digest.

requirements.statement: Every change MUST identify scope, affected requirements and actual evidence or explicit blockers.
requirements.verification: Validate a handoff/PR checklist and a deliberately incomplete record.

requirements.statement: Bootstrap tooling MUST never execute work definitions or mutate physical storage/GitHub state.
requirements.verification: Inspect code paths and exercise all commands against fixture directories.

requirements.statement: Generated context and indexes MUST be deterministic and detect changed source inputs.
requirements.verification: Repeat generation and compare, then corrupt one input.

requirements.statement: Validation failures MUST be nonzero and explicit; partial checks MUST NOT be called complete qualification.
requirements.verification: Negative test matrix across YAML, JSON Schema, links and work DAG.

requirements.statement: Every distributed artifact MUST match an independently reviewed nonempty staging inventory with required entrypoints and safe unique paths.
requirements.verification: Before release, test empty-but-valid, missing, extra, duplicate/case-colliding, traversal and changed-byte archives against the staging contract.

requirements.statement: Publication evidence MUST distinguish local packaging checks, delivered-byte checks, authenticity and product qualification, and MUST report unexecuted checks as not run.
requirements.verification: Review a release record with a missing download check or runtime evidence; no publication/runtime success may be inferred from checksum equality.

requirements.statement: Extensions MUST use explicit versioned contracts and authority tiers; installation or syntactic conformance MUST NOT grant storage authority.
requirements.verification: Reject unadmitted plugins, unknown critical features and language-private ABI types; compare typed frontend/provider conformance transcripts.

requirements.statement: Implementation MUST proceed through explicit phase gates; no physical mutation may be admitted by completing a fake/image-only milestone.
requirements.verification: Inspect work dependency/gate graph.

requirements.statement: Every selected work unit MUST have bounded outputs, context, tests and a needs-review stop state.
requirements.verification: Validate the work catalog and export projection.

requirements.statement: Unresolved decisions MUST block only their affected implementation/release scopes and MUST remain visible in work readiness.
requirements.verification: Decision-gate test with unrelated read-only work remaining eligible.

requirements.statement: A superseded proposal MUST retain its rationale and replacement identity rather than disappearing from history.
requirements.verification: Inspect decision catalog and migration entries.

requirements.statement: External implementation claims MUST be tied to inspected source revisions or marked unverified/inherited.
requirements.verification: Inspect source registry and integration gates.

requirements.statement: `target.inventory` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Duplicate USB serials, cloned GUIDs, inaccessible volume, removed device, stale ordinal, sleeping media, enormous provider response and cancellation mid-enumeration.

requirements.statement: `table.verify` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: EBR cycle, array multiplication overflow, GPT valid-but-disagreeing copies, truncated image, invalid UTF-16 name, overlapping entries and hot-removal.

requirements.statement: `image.acquire` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Destination equals source through alias, full destination, thin-provisioning exhaustion, disconnected device, corrupt map, resumed different disk, read substitution and destination file preexistence.

requirements.statement: `table.gpt.repair` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Crash before/after each metadata write/flush, altered backup, shortened device, overlapping entry arrays, wrong sector size and unrelated-byte changes.

requirements.statement: `partition.edit.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Active page-file volume, stale partition ID, hidden metadata in a gap, delete-vs-erase confusion, duplicate GUID, interrupted table write and follow-up format without approval.

requirements.statement: `filesystem.grow-right.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Nonadjacent free space, capacity race, filesystem maximum, encryption layer, grow-provider success with unchanged filesystem and failure after boundary growth.

requirements.statement: `filesystem.shrink-right.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Immovable metadata, unsupported filesystem, XP without qualifying provider, hibernation, failed relocation, stale minimum size and power loss before filesystem commit.

requirements.statement: `partition.move.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Overlap both directions, power loss at every chunk, media error, changed device, corrupt checkpoint, boot reference mismatch, insufficient independent recovery storage and canceled irreversible stage.

requirements.statement: `filesystem.migrate.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Case-fold name collisions, unsupported resource forks/ADS, lost hardlinks, changed source, ACL translation ambiguity, timestamp precision loss and encrypted per-file data.

requirements.statement: `boot.offline.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: USB order change, BitLocker protector mismatch, invalid BCD, missing NVMe driver, inaccessible recovery medium, power interruption and normal boot returning before operation completion.

requirements.statement: `health.assess` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: No SMART over bridge, forged serial, media deterioration, accidental self-test, secret leakage, repaired original mislabeled forensic and incomplete acquisition hashes.

requirements.statement: `media.destructive.plan` MUST enforce the preconditions, evidence and recovery limits in this operation contract before admission.
requirements.verification: Wrong namespace, vendor mismatch, power loss, fake sanitize success, blocked secure state, shared-array collateral effects and ordinary format mislabeled secure erase.

requirements.statement: Formatting MUST bind exact container identity, filesystem feature/consumer choices, effects and loss acknowledgement; unsupported options MUST NOT be silently replaced.
requirements.verification: Image fixtures cover stale container, active consumer, unsupported allocation/features, source/recovery alias, provider substitution and out-of-footprint changes.

requirements.statement: Formatting MUST NOT imply sanitization, rollback, mountability or bootability without separate evidence, and MUST retain uncertain interruption outcomes.
requirements.verification: Exercise quick/full/discard distinctions, false formatter success, interrupted initialization and absent consumer tests; verify truthful results.
